duration.text: The Electrical information at Nanjing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

materials.text: NJUPT application form (fill in online).Notarized highest diploma. Prospective diploma winners must submit official proof of student status by their current university.Academic transcripts (from the undergraduate program onwards). Copies of academic records from first to last semester during the undergraduate, master (if any), and PhD programs (if any) shall be provided.Language proficiency certificate.Passport home page, valid for more than 1 year. Resume.FOREIGNER PHYSICAL EXAMINATION FORM.Award certificate.Bank statement (over 2500USD).List of papers published in professional or scientific journals, or representative papers, or abstracts of articles (optional).Research proposal (at least 3000 words in Chinese or English).Two recommendation letters from professors or associate professors, written only in Chinese or English.Non-criminal record report.https://overseas.njupt.edu.cn/FilesDonload/list.htmhttps://yjs.njupt.edu.cn/dsgl/nocontrol/college/dsfc.htmNJUPT Provisional Acceptance Letter (PhD). Download the form at：https://overseas.njupt.edu.cn/FilesDownload/list.htmSupervisor information link:https://yjs.njupt.edu.cn/dsgl/nocontrol/college/dsfc.htm

requirements.text: Non-Chinese citizens, in good physical and mental health.Applicants seeking a bachelor's degree should possess a high school diploma or equivalent qualifications, demonstrate outstanding academic performance, and generally be under the age of 25 years.Applicants seeking a master's degree should possess a bachelor's degree or equivalent qualifications, demonstrate outstanding academic performance, and generally be under the age of 35 years.Applicants seeking a doctoral degree should possess a master's degree or equivalent qualifications, demonstrate outstanding academic performance, and generally be under the age of 40 years.Applicants seeking bachelor's, master's, or doctoral degrees with Chinese as the medium of instruction should have Chinese proficiency at least at Level 4 of the Hanyu Shuiping Kaoshi (HSK).Applicants seeking bachelor's, master's, or doctoral degrees with English as the medium of instruction should have an English proficiency level of at least 5.5 in IELTS, 72 in TOEFL, or 100 in Duolingo.
